_doc.purpose: OnDialogue_Permissions request events for the sex_* permissions; same flow as Permissions_Intimacy.json (see its _doc, which also holds the shared Permission_Request_* event text). Kojo: Permission_[id]_Request / _Granted / _Refused, one set per permission. Kept in a file named *Sex* so safe mode skips it.
